skill.name: activecampaign-automation
skill.description: Guide ActiveCampaign CRM workflows through Rube MCP, including contacts, tags, list subscriptions, automation enrollment, and contact tasks.
skill.summary: Guide ActiveCampaign contact, tagging, list, automation, and task workflows through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code for Rube tools, ActiveCampaign tools, parameters, and examples. The external Rube MCP endpoint is a real low-severity network dependency, and the skill has medium operational risk because it can mutate CRM records and marketing membership.

remediation.suggestion: Document that Rube MCP is a third-party service and require users to approve the connection before CRM workflows run.
Require explicit confirmation before contact creation, tag changes, list updates, automation enrollment, task creation, or bulk changes.
Validate list IDs, automation IDs, task type IDs, assignee IDs, and contact IDs before executing write actions.

content.value_statement: ActiveCampaign work can require repeated contact, tag, list, automation, and task updates. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Search for existing ActiveCampaign contacts by email, ID, or phone.
Create contacts with names, phone numbers, organizations, job titles, and tags.
Add or remove contact tags using contact IDs or email addresses.
Subscribe or unsubscribe contacts from lists when list IDs are known.
Enroll existing contacts in active automation workflows.
Create contact tasks with due dates, task types, notes, assignees, and status values.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active ActiveCampaign connection before use.
Does not create ActiveCampaign automations or list IDs.
Requires valid IDs for lists, automations, task types, and assignees.
Can change CRM records, so sensitive actions need user approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare New Lead Records
use_cases.description: Find or create contacts, add initial tags, and capture key profile fields before campaign follow-up.

use_cases.title: Manage Campaign Membership
use_cases.description: Subscribe or unsubscribe contacts from known lists while using the required ActiveCampaign IDs.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Follow-Up Tasks
use_cases.description: Create contact tasks with due dates, task types, notes, and assignees after verifying contact IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Find Or Create Contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ActiveCampaign automation skill to find contact jane@example.com. If no exact match exists, create Jane Lee with phone 555-0100 and tag webinar-lead.

prompt_templates.title: Update Tags And List
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the contact for alex@example.com, add the customer tag, and subscribe the contact to list ID 12. Show the planned changes before running write actions.

prompt_templates.title: Enroll In Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify that sam@example.com exists, then enroll the contact in active automation ID 44. Ask for confirmation before the enrollment action.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Bulk Tagging
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a rate-limit aware plan to add the onboarding tag to this approved contact list. Use contact_email when possible and pause for confirmation before executing.

output_examples.input: Find or create jane@example.com and apply the webinar-lead tag.
output_examples.output: The contact was found. The webinar-lead tag is planned for that contact, pending user confirmation.
The contact was matched by email. The list subscription change is ready and uses list ID 12.

output_examples.input: Create a follow-up task for contact ID 123 due tomorrow at 10 AM Eastern.
output_examples.output: The task request includes the contact ID and due time. A task type ID is still required before creation.

best_practices: Search Rube tools first so the current ActiveCampaign schemas are used.
Confirm list, automation, task type, and assignee IDs before write actions.
Preview CRM changes and ask before subscriptions, automation enrollment, or bulk updates.
anti_patterns: Running bulk changes without confirming the exact contact list.
Using list or automation names when numeric IDs are required.
Assuming tag and subscription action capitalization rules are interchangeable.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Rube MCP must be configured, and the ActiveCampaign connection must show ACTIVE before workflows run.

faq.question: Can this skill create ActiveCampaign automations?
faq.answer: No. It can enroll existing contacts in active automations, but automation creation happens in ActiveCampaign.

faq.question: Does this skill need list IDs?
faq.answer: Yes. List subscription actions require numeric list ID strings, not list names.

faq.question: Can it update an existing contact?
faq.answer: Yes. Creating a contact with an existing email may update the existing contact.

faq.question: Can it process bulk tagging work?
faq.answer: Yes, but batches should use reasonable delays and respect ActiveCampaign rate limits.

faq.question: How does it handle changing tool schemas?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to search Rube tools first so current schemas are used.
